byteward.sentence: A ransomware attack hit Marrowfield Health's computer systems on Friday.
The chain runs 11 hospitals across Merrow County and its neighbors.
Ambulances are being diverted away from four of those hospitals.
Doctors and nurses have gone back to paper records.
A group calling itself Brinewolf has claimed responsibility for the attack.

bench-and-bill.sentence: Marrowfield Health was hit by ransomware on Friday.
A group called Brinewolf says it carried out the attack.
According to a notice Marrowfield Health filed with state regulators, the group demanded $8 million.
Investigators believe the attackers got in through a flaw in a remote-access gateway.
On Saturday, the National Cyber Readiness Office ordered hospitals to patch that flaw within 72 hours.
Hospitals that miss the deadline face fines of up to $25,000 a day.

launch-desk.sentence: Ransomware struck Marrowfield Health on Friday.
It reported $3.4 billion in revenue last year.
Marrowfield Health has postponed elective surgeries through Tuesday.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: Ransomware hit Marrowfield Health on Friday.
The entry point was a flaw in a remote-access gateway, the box staff use to log in from outside.
A fix for that flaw has been available since September.
Once inside, the ransomware encrypted about 1,900 computers.
Marrowfield Health's offline backups weren't touched.
